text: 眼下你没有受到直接威胁，可以自由搜查哈里斯家，不过你得动作快些，以防有人找来。你环顾所在的起居室，发现这里因先前的冲突而有些凌乱。
你望向入口处，看到门厅里堆满箱子、板条箱和其他被防尘布盖住的认不出是什么的物品。你探头查看隔壁房间，发现那里有厨房和相邻的餐厅，两处都维护得一尘不染，不过陈设稀少。
你掀开门厅里的防尘布，发现下面有各种家具和装饰品，还有一摞又一摞的书。其中许多是历史著作和参考书，有些是哈里斯教授本人撰写的。此外还有大量普通科学著作和文学作品，这倒符合一位受过良好教育之人的藏书。
你把防尘布重新盖好，觉得这里不会有什么有价值的发现。你转而把注意力放到入口对面的楼梯上。你上楼后看到两扇门，分列两侧。左边的门虚掩着，通向卧室。排除其他可能，右边的门一定通向书房。它似乎锁着，而你先前搜查房屋时没有找到钥匙。若花足够时间，你或许能把门弄开，但最好别在这上面耗太久，因为阿米莉娅或她的熟人可能很快就会回来。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 179
text: With no immediate threat to yourself, you’re free to explore the Harris household, though you do so quickly in case someone comes looking. Glancing about the sitting room you’re in, you find it’s in a bit of a mess from the earlier scuffle.

Looking toward the entrance, you note the foyer, filled with boxes, crates, and other unidentifiable objects covered with dust sheets. You poke your head into the next room and find a kitchen and adjacent dining room, both spotlessly maintained though sparsely furnished.

Peeking beneath the dust sheets in the entryway, you find various items of furniture and décor, as well as stacks and stacks of books. Many of them are historical texts and reference materials, some of which were written by Prof. Harris himself. There is also a large number of general works of science and literature, as befits any well-educated man.

You place the covers back down, sensing that you will find nothing of value here. You turn your attention instead to the set of stairs opposite the entrance. You ascend the staircase and see two doors, one to either side of you. The door to your left is slightly ajar, and leads to the bedroom. By a process of elimination, the door to your right must lead to the study. It seems to be locked and your earlier search of the house did not yield a key. With enough time, you might be able to get the door open, but it would probably be unwise to spend too long trying since Amelia or one of those close to her may return soon.
